main_text.l: DEMOMSTRATIO
IMPLEMENTI
AD DIVINITATEM
FIRMANDAM.
Supponentes iterum prophetiarum implementa
divinam earundem simul confirmare originem,
restat tantum modo, ut quousque hujus scenæ
prædictiones sint adimpletæ ostendamus.
I. Fugatam fuisse (& ferè sine manu, post Judaeo-
rum excidium) gentem, antea supra totum fere orbem
dominatam, jam quasi à rupe suâ venditam, ut cum
suis idololatriis aliis locum cedere coacta fuerit, videre licet
in imperii Romani gentilis subitaneâ immutatione; quan-
do Constantinus Maxentium, Licinius Maximinum vi-
cit, & uterque Christianis libertatem cultus publici ex
composito concessit. Audiamus Lactantium, rem om-
nem exponentem: ille in libro de mortibus Persecuto-
rum Constantini victoriam cap. 44. In hunc modum
describit. „Bellum per idoneos duces gerebatur.
„Plus virium Maxentio erat, quod & patris sui exerc-
itum receperat à Severo, & suum proprium de
„Mauris atque Italis nuper extraxerat. Dimicatum,

page.notes: Printed "Demomstratio" in the title is a printing error, left as printed. The word "tantum modo" is partly shadowed by a stain; the reading "tantum" is doubtful. The initial S is a woodcut and is joined to "upponentes" as "Supponentes". The reading of the line-start quotation marks („) is uncertain, as is whether the first one is a quotation mark or a dash. Ink spots and foxing lie over the left-centre of the page, and some letters in "Fugatam", "Constantinus" and "subitaneâ" are hard to make out. No marginal notes are visible.
